notes.title: Chat notifications
items: Turn on Notifications at the top of Chats and Setline tells you when a friend writes: in Friends, a private chat or one of your rooms. Everyone stays quiet.
In the browser it's instant, on Android, on a computer, and on iPhone once Setline is on your Home Screen (Share, then Add to Home Screen).
In the iPhone app, Setline checks in the background, so a notification can come a little after the message.

notes.title: Chats: Everyone, private and your own rooms
items: The Chat row in Friends is now Chats. Everyone is one conversation with every Setline lifter, for questions anyone can answer.
Tap Message to talk to one friend in private. Only the two of you see it.
Start a room on any topic, like Leg day crew or Meal prep, and pick the friends who join. Leave it whenever you like; if you started it, you can delete it.
Add a photo to any message: your plate, your PR, the gym.

notes.title: Your plan and your profile
items: Nutrition now has Your plan, right under today's numbers: your weight, your goal and whether you're heading the right way, in one card. Tap Open your plan for everything.

Add your height, sex and age there, and Setline works out what you burn and what your goal asks you to eat, using the formulas sports dietitians use. Every number shows where it comes from: tap Sources.
One tap sets those numbers as your calorie and protein targets.
Your profile is one tap from the top of Friends: your streak, your weight and goal, every badge (with how close you are to the next) and the photos from your posts.
Fixed: a workout posted with a friend didn't show what you trained. Every post now lists its exercises, with or without a friend named.

notes.title: Chat with your friends
items: There's a chat at the top of the Friends tab: one conversation with your friends, to ask about a workout or a meal, or to cheer each other on.
Tag a message Training, Food or Motivation so a question stands out. Tap your own message to delete it, or a friend's to report or block.
Only you and your friends see it. A green dot on the Chat row means a friend wrote something since you last looked.

notes.title: Swap in one tap
items: Similar exercises now sit right under the exercise you're on, as cards you can swipe through. Each shows the muscle it works and how close a match it is. Tap one to swap; Undo puts it back.
The cards stay until you log your first set of that exercise. The Swap button is still there for everything else: pain, changing your plan, or your own exercise.
Updates like this one now open by themselves when you open the app, once. Tap Got it and they're out of the way; you can always find them again in Settings › What's new.

notes.title: Your feedback, built in
items: Make your own week: in Plan & workouts, pick a workout for every day (one of yours or one from your plan) and it repeats every week. No more changing it day by day.

With your own week on, Settings and Plan & workouts say so, and your plan is shown as where its workouts come from. Changing plan shape tells you first: your week stays with the old plan and comes back if you switch back.
Send a workout to a friend: tap the share button next to one of your workouts and send the link in WhatsApp, Messages or any chat. Your friend taps it and saves a copy, on iPhone or Android.
Logging a set: Paused, Partial, Failed and Drop set now sit under every set of every exercise. Nothing is ticked for you anymore, so a set only counts as paused if you say so.
Sets without weight: step the weight down to 0, or type 0, for bodyweight sets like pull-ups without a belt. Drop sets can go down to 0 kg too.
Every exercise can now be done one side at a time. Tap “One side” and pick left or right.
Swapping an exercise: every option now shows the muscle it works and a match meter, best matches first. One tap swaps it in.
Rest timer: tap the time to type your own rest, like 2:30 or 90. The exercise keeps that rest for the rest of the workout. There's a −30 button now too.
Android: when you leave the app during a rest, your notifications show when the rest ends, and you get a buzz when it's over. Allow notifications when the app asks.
This page: every update, in plain words. A green dot on Settings means there's something new.

notes.title: Setline in your browser
items: Setline now runs in any browser, Android included, with the same account as the iPhone app.
Sign-in and password-reset links bring you straight back into the app.
Leaving a workout you picked up again keeps it, instead of throwing it away.
Your own workouts: one row per exercise, and Save or Cancel when you build one.
Workout places show on a real map, and you can name the friends you trained with.
